# Attribution — Superpowers skills

The skills in this directory are imported from **Superpowers**, an agentic skills
framework and software development methodology by Jesse Vincent.

- Source: https://github.com/obra/superpowers
- Version: 7.0.1
- Commit: `2ce8aa15d05bd57213e6f746f953aafb7ded7a8b` (2026-10-21)
- License: MIT

Only the `skills/` directory was copied. Claude Code specific pieces (plugin
manifests, hooks, marketplace files) were not imported; the behavior they provide
at session start is replicated by
[`../instructions/superpowers.instructions.md`](../instructions/superpowers.instructions.md).
The only local changes are the VS Code Copilot port notes in
`using-superpowers/references/vscode-copilot-tools.md` and its entry in the
"Platform Adaptation" list.
